info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Warehouse Inventory Reorders-v4-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the list of warehouse inventory reorder items, allowing businesses to monitor and manage inventory effectively. Users can retrieve detailed insights on items that require reordering, ensuring optimal stock levels are maintained. Typically, warehouse managers and inventory control teams utilize this API to streamline restocking processes and avoid stockouts. The endpoint assists in proactive inventory management, empowering organizations to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

get.description: Fetches the current inventory levels and identifies items that need to be reordered to maintain optimal stock levels.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for reordering inventory items. It should contain the necessary details to successfully initiate a reorder operation, ensuring that the appropriate items are restocked based on the current inventory levels.

200.description: Successful retrieval of inventory reorder information.

ListWarehouseInventoryReordersRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the GET operation to reorder inventory. It is represented as a string.

ListWarehouseInventoryReordersResponse_2.title: Reorder Inventory Response

status.description: Indicates whether the reorder operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reorder request.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the reorder operation.

state.description: The current state of the reorder operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the reorder operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message regarding the reorder operation.

ListWarehouseInventoryReordersResponse_2.description: Response schema for the successful inventory reorder operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the reorder request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reorder request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reorder operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details related to the audit of the reorder operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
